title: Band-9 Samples: Did you enjoy the summer holidays when you were at school? [Why/why not?]
content:
This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 16 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 4 Test 3 question:

“Did you enjoy the summer holidays when you were at school? [Why/why not?]”

Sample 1: Yes

Absolutely, I cherished those summer holidays back in my school days. They provided a well-deserved break from academics, allowing me to let my hair down and explore my hobbies. Plus, the sunny weather was perfect for outdoor adventures with friends and family.

Sample 2: Yes

I thoroughly enjoyed the summer holidays while I was at school. It was a period of respite, where I could indulge in my hobbies and passions, like reading and painting, without the constraints of a hectic schedule. Not to mention, it was also a chance to catch up on much-needed sleep!

Sample 3: Yes

Indeed, I was over the moon during my school summer holidays. It was a time when I could step back from the daily hustle and bustle and savor the simple pleasures in life. From lazy afternoons spent with a good book to impromptu trips to the beach, those carefree days left an indelible mark on my heart.

Sample 4: Yes

Summer holidays at school were undoubtedly a highlight of my year. They presented a golden opportunity for personal growth, as I could engage in a myriad of activities that piqued my interest. Additionally, the warm weather facilitated many convivial gatherings with my friends and family.

Sample 5: No

Unfortunately, I didn’t derive much pleasure from my summer holidays during my school days. My family faced financial constraints, which meant that we couldn’t indulge in leisure activities or travel. Consequently, I spent most of my time helping my parents with household chores and part-time jobs, leaving little room for relaxation or fun.

Sample 6: No

Looking back, I realize that summer holidays were somewhat lackluster during my school years. I lived in a small town with limited entertainment options, which often led to boredom and a feeling of being trapped. I found solace in my imagination and daydreams, but couldn’t escape the desire for more engaging and stimulating experiences.

Sample 7: No

As strange as it may sound, I wasn’t a fan of summer holidays back in my school days. I grew up in a bustling city, so the scorching heat and humidity made it almost unbearable to venture outdoors. Consequently, I spent most of my time cooped up at home, longing for the cooler months.

Sample 8: No

Summer holidays weren’t my cup of tea during my school years. The sudden break in routine left me feeling disoriented, and I struggled to fill the void with meaningful activities. I often found myself counting down the days until school resumed, as I yearned for the familiar rhythm of classes, homework, and extracurricular activities.

Sample 9: Neutral

Summer holidays during my school days were a mixed bag for me. On one hand, I relished the break from the daily grind and the chance to unwind. However, I also missed the camaraderie of my classmates and the intellectual stimulation from lessons. Overall, it was a balanced experience.

Sample 10: Neutral

Reflecting on my school days, I can’t say I was particularly enamored with summer holidays, nor did I abhor them. They offered a welcome hiatus from the rigors of studying, but occasionally, I would experience bouts of listlessness, longing for some engagement or structure.
